jobgether-jobgether:lever:1098c769-7ebc-.title: Structural & Architectural Design Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:1098c769-7ebc-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Structural & Architectural Design Engineer based in United Kingdom. As a Structural & Architectural Design Engineer, you’ll contribute to the design of a major AI data center infrastructure project with demanding structural and operational requirements. You’ll work across building envelope, internal layouts, structural load-bearing systems, life safety, lighting, and technological infrastructure pathways. Your designs will need to support high-density AI computing and liquid-cooled equipment while maintaining resilience, security, and operational efficiency. You’ll collaborate closely with MEP engineers and other technical specialists to ensure architectural and structural solutions are fully integrated. The role also involves reviewing design-build packages, identifying risks, supporting permitting, and ensuring compliance with applicable building and fire-safety regulations. You’ll work in an international, technically complex environment where practical engineering judgment and attention to detail are highly valued. This is an opportunity to apply your structural and architectural expertise to next-generation critical infrastructure with significant future scalability. Design building envelope systems , including exterior walls, façades, roofing, and thermal and moisture insulation suitable for critical data center environments. Develop internal partitioning and space-planning solutions, including white-space and gray-space separation, security zones, fire compartments, corridors, and access-control layouts. Perform structural load calculations for raised floors, POD and racking areas, and rooftop mechanical equipment such as coolers and pump skids. Calculate floor-loading capacity for IT racks, including high-density liquid-cooled racks and CDU placement zones. Design tunnels and technological infrastructure pathways for cable trays, piping, and other critical services. Develop lighting concepts for white space, gray space, offices, exterior areas, and security zones in line with data center operational requirements. Coordinate architectural and structural drawings with MEP teams, accounting for equipment loads, ceiling heights, structural clearances, cooling-pipe routes, and electrical distribution. Review architectural and structural components of design-build packages, identifying technical risks, inconsistencies, and potential value-engineering opportunities. Ensure designs comply with applicable local building codes, fire-safety regulations, and facility resilience requirements . Coordinate with local authorities and relevant stakeholders on structural and architectural permitting matters. Support long-term space planning and design strategies that allow the facility to scale as infrastructure and computing requirements evolve. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience in structural and/or architectural design , ideally involving industrial, warehouse, manufacturing, critical infrastructure, or similarly complex facilities. Demonstrated experience designing load-intensive facilities , including raised floors, heavy stationary equipment, and structures requiring detailed load calculations. Direct data center experience is beneficial but not mandatory; relevant experience from industrial, warehouse, manufacturing, or comparable environments is fully applicable. Proficiency with AutoCAD and/or Revit . Experience with at least one structural calculation package, such as Tekla Structures, Autodesk Robot Structural Analysis, IDEA StatiCa, or Dlubal RFEM . Proven ability to coordinate multidisciplinary designs and manage interfaces between structural, architectural, and MEP disciplines. Strong understanding of structural design principles, building layouts, space planning, and technical coordination. Ability to identify design risks, inconsistencies, and practical optimization opportunities

jobgether-jobgether:lever:76850074-9e39-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Banking Onboarding Manager based in Ireland. As a Banking Onboarding Manager, you will take ownership of complex corporate banking and EMI onboarding across multiple jurisdictions and high-risk industries. You will act as a key link between internal Finance and Legal teams and external banking partners, relationship managers, and compliance officers. Your expertise will help secure and maintain critical corporate accounts while ensuring demanding underwriting and regulatory requirements are met. You will manage KYC, KYB, and AML processes, coordinate detailed corporate documentation, and keep applications moving efficiently from submission through approval. The role requires strong knowledge of international banking, complex ownership structures, and compliance requirements, combined with persistence and excellent organization. You will also support ongoing banking relationships through annual reviews, transaction queries, and corporate structure updates. This is a highly autonomous, globally oriented role where your work directly supports the stability and scalability of essential financial operations. Own end-to-end onboarding and account-opening processes for operational and client bank and EMI accounts across multiple jurisdictions. Manage banking applications within high-risk industries, ensuring all requirements are understood, documented, and addressed accurately. Gather, review, structure, and submit corporate legal files, UBO ownership documentation, and operational flowcharts required for bank underwriting. Build and maintain strong working relationships with bank relationship managers, compliance officers, EMIs, and other financial partners. Track active applications closely, proactively follow up on outstanding requirements, and resolve issues to minimize account setup delays. Lead KYC, KYB, and AML processes, including complex onboarding cases, annual reviews, and ad-hoc compliance inquiries. Coordinate responses to transaction-related questions and provide banking partners with accurate and timely supporting information. Manage annual bank reviews and ensure corporate accounts remain compliant with changing requirements. Communicate corporate structure changes to relevant banking and financial partners and coordinate any resulting documentation or review processes. Support Finance and Legal teams with substance requirements across the corporate holding structure. Interpret and coordinate legal documentation such as Certificates of Incorporation, Registers of Directors, Incumbency Certificates, Powers of Attorney, and apostilled documents. Help manage banking and payment relationships across international payment routes, including SEPA and SWIFT. Maintain clear records of onboarding progress, documentation, requests, approvals, and outstanding actions. Identify potential onboarding or compliance bottlenecks early and work proactively with internal and external stakeholders to resolve them. Contribute to the ongoing improvement of banking onboarding processes, documentation standards, and partner-management practices. Requirements 3+ years of hands-on experience opening and managing corporate bank or EMI accounts, ideally within iGaming, cryptocurrency, high-risk FinTech, or another highly regulated environment. Strong understanding of complex UBO and corporate ownership structures and the documentation required to evidence them. Proven knowledge of bank underwriting requirements, apostilled documentation, and international corporate banking processes. Deep understanding of KYC, KYB, and AML requirements, including AML regulations and Source of Wealth (SoW) and Source of Funds (SoF) assessments. Strong legal literacy and confidence working with corporate documentation, including M&A documents, Certificates of Incorporation, Registers of Directors, Incumbency Certificates, Powers of Attor

jobgether-jobgether:lever:fbd8dea3-5f12-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Performance Marketing Motion Designer / Video Editor based in Netherlands. This role is designed for a creative professional who combines strong visual storytelling with a genuine interest in performance marketing and data. You will create, edit, and animate paid social creatives designed not only to look compelling, but also to generate measurable business results. Working closely with creative and marketing teams, you will develop concepts, test variations, analyze performance, and continuously improve advertising assets. The position offers exposure to multiple digital platforms, including Meta, TikTok, and YouTube, as well as a wide range of creative formats. You will use performance metrics to understand why certain creative decisions succeed and translate those insights into stronger future campaigns. The role also encourages the use of AI-powered creative tools to accelerate ideation, production, and experimentation without compromising quality. It is an opportunity to combine motion design, video editing, visual communication, and data-driven creative strategy in a fast-paced environment. Conceptualize, design, edit, and animate static and video assets for performance-focused social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other digital platforms. Translate marketing objectives, audience insights, and campaign goals into engaging creative concepts designed to drive measurable actions. Break down successful advertisements into key components such as hooks, problems, solutions, proof points, offers, and calls to action, then develop modular variations for structured A/B testing. Review creative performance data and use metrics such as CTR, CPA, ROAS, CVR, CPM, CPC, VTR, thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and watch time to identify performance patterns. Analyze individual creative assets to determine which visual, messaging, storytelling, and editing choices contribute to stronger results. Turn campaign data and stakeholder feedback into actionable creative iterations rather than relying solely on personal design preferences. Manage complete post-production workflows, including video editing, sound design, VFX, motion graphics, dynamic typography, color correction, and creative adaptation. Adapt successful creatives into multiple versions, placements, aspect ratios, and formats while maintaining clear organization, naming conventions, and version control. Research competitor advertising, platform trends, audience behavior, and high-performing creative formats to identify new concepts and testing opportunities. Manage assigned creative projects from initial brief through final delivery while communicating effectively with creative, marketing, and account teams. Use AI-powered tools for image generation, video production, copy development, ideation, experimentation, and workflow optimization. Apply strong principles of composition, color, typography, hierarchy, pacing, and visual storytelling to create content that communicates clearly and converts effectively. Manage multiple creative projects, deadlines, and variations while maintaining a high standard of quality and attention to detail. Requirements 3–5 years of professional experience in motion design, video editing, performance creative, or a closely related field. Strong portfolio demonstrating motion design, video editing, paid social creative, and social-first storytelling. Proven experience creating performance-oriented advertisements for platforms such as Meta, TikTok, and YouTube. Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics, including CTR, CPA, ROAS, CVR, CPM, CPC, and video engagement metrics such as watch time. Demonstrated ability to analyze creative performance and turn data-driven insights into specific, actionable recommendations.
